name: Badminton Varsity Squad
description: To join the Varsity Badminton team, you will need to attend trials during week 1 and be selected. The team will train for approximately 3 hours per week, focusing on developing your skills and knowledge in preparation for competitive events, including the SSSA. Please note that you are expected to purchase the team kit, which costs around 190 RMB.

name: Basketball Social Scrimmage
description: Basketball social scrimmage is an opportunity for players of all levels to play basketball. Priority will be given to non-varsity players. The sessions will involve constant gameplay and changing teams.

name: Girls Varsity Basketball
description: Varsity basketball is a year long commitment, including during exam periods. Students are expected to attend all practices, complete their strength and conditioning program in their own time and be available for all matches and tournaments. The team competes in both the SSSA and Junior NBA competitions.

description: Varsity basketball is a year long commitment, including during exam periods. name: Chess
description: Welcome YK Pao Grand Masters! Students will have the opportunity to challenge themselves and their peers (and Mr. Craig) in the timeless game of Chess. Over the course of the season students will engage in a ladder tournament in which they challenge and are challenged by their peers. Additionally, there will be special days for chess derivatives such as Chess 960, Hand & Brain, Bughouse, 'All Pieces are Knights'. All skill levels are warmly welcomed.

name: Digital Art with Vectors and Image Editing
description: Digital Art provides students with an opportunity to develop creative and technical skills using industry-standard design tools such as Adobe and Affinity for vector graphics and image editing. Open to students of all experience levels, this activity explores the principles of digital design, illustration, photo manipulation, and visual communication. Students will create original artwork, logos, digital illustrations, and other creative projects while learning techniques such as layering, colour theory, composition, and typography. Final products may include posters, stickers, digital media, and printed designs for clothing and other merchandise, allowing students to see their ideas develop from concept to finished product.

name: ENCORE Theatre - Route A
description: ENCORE Theatre Group A will perform a short play on January 20 and 21, 2027 in the Drama Studio. Sign up to become a performer, designer, technician, stage manager, or stagehand. Auditions for casting will be held in September.

name: ENCORE Theatre - Route B
description: ENCORE Theatre Group B will perform a short play on Jun 16 and 17, 2027 in the Drama Studio. Sign up to become a performer, designer, technician, stage manager, or stagehand. Auditions for casting will be held in December 2026. Study leave will not be accepted as a reason for absence from any rehearsal. Attendance is compulsory.

name: Entomology Club
description: The Entomology Club introduces students to the fascinating world of insects through hands-on observation, research, and creative exploration. This CCA is designed to spark curiosity about biodiversity while developing skills in observation, recording, statistical analysis and environmental awareness. The club welcomes both beginners and budding naturalists, offering a variety of activities ranging from behaviour experiments, documentaries and promotion of public awareness.

name: Entrepreneurship Club
description: Students will have the opportunity to learn the basic challenges that entrepreneurs face when starting out in the world of business.

name: European Humanities
description: Originating from a European humanistic perspective, our sessions introduce the IB history style learning method through exploration of global historical themes. From stories to historical research methods, then to articles with unique perspectives. As part of the UHHC National Humanities Alliance, your articles can be published nationwide.

name: Inner Chord
description: Inner Chord is committed to promoting the application of creative therapy in children's psychological intervention, especially for children with autism or developmental delays. We partner with Star of Joy Growth Center, an organization under the Shanghai Disabled Persons' Federation, public schools and other student-led clubs, to offer members opportunities such as ABA behaviour intervention training, in-person volunteer services, and the design of related programmes and activities.

name: Oxbridge Preparation Programme (Y10)
description: Open to selected students who are considering applying to Oxford or Cambridge University. This is an opportunity for you to learn more about the application, admissions and learning style at Oxford and Cambridge, as well as develop your supercurricular research in order to fully understand what it takes to be a successful Oxbridge applicant.

name: Varsity Pickleball 1
